brief: The Annunciation commemorates the event in Luke’s Gospel in which the angel Gabriel comes to Mary with the message that she is to bear a son. In telling Mary this, Gabriel also points to some key images by which Jesus is to be understood: he will be “Son of the Most High”; he will be the descendant of David who will reign for ever; he will be “Son of God”. The feast is observed on 25 March, nine months before Christmas Day.
